title: Winter Skydive 3D
description: Leap into crisp alpine skies, glide through glowing aerial rings, steer past snowy peaks, and nail a bullseye parachute touchdown.
controls: Drag to steer your skydiver through score rings and guide your parachute cleanly onto the landing target.

zh-CN.title: 冬日极限跳伞
zh-CN.description: 清爽畅快 3D 冬日极限跳伞：从雪山高空纵身跃下，穿梭空中光环躲避冰峰，精准控伞稳稳降落靶心赢高分！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动屏幕控制跳伞角色穿过空中得分环，避开雪山障碍精准降落在靶心区域。
